part2.question: Describe a time you made an important decision and were happy with the result

segments.v: I want to talk about an important decision I made last summer. I decided to go to my grandparents' village to teach English to children. My parents wanted me to study in a summer class in Hà Nội, but I wanted to help the children because they didn't have many chances to learn English. It was not easy to decide because my parents were worried about my study. We talked a lot and they agreed. I taught about fifteen children for three weeks. At first it was difficult because the children didn't listen. Then I used games and songs and they liked it. I was happy with the result because the children learned many things and they were very happy. I also became more confident. My study was not affected. I think it was a good decision.
